# ScrollHeart

> Build her a story she can scroll through.

ScrollHeart is a warm, gentle AI skill that helps a boy create a romantic, scroll-driven storytelling website for a girl he cares about.

## Skill Documentation

- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) - Core skill file with 5-phase workflow and brand voice
- [Interview Flow](references/01-interview-flow.md) - 10-question conversational interview
- [Safety Checklist](references/02-safety-checklist.md) - Red flag detection and relationship calibration
- [Design Brief Generator](references/03-design-brief-generator.md) - Answer-to-design-spec conversion
- [Scene Templates](references/04-scene-templates.md) - 5-scene narrative arc and parallax layers
- [Code Generation Rules](references/05-code-generation-rules.md) - HTML/CSS/JS templates and GSAP config
- [Deployment Guide](references/06-deployment-guide.md) - GitHub Pages setup and privacy measures
- [Post-Build Guide](references/07-post-build-guide.md) - How to present the gift and handle responses

## Resources

- [Color Palettes](resources/color-palettes.json) - 4 mood-based color palettes
- [Font Pairings](resources/font-pairings.json) - 4 personality-based typography sets
- [Song Suggestions](resources/song-suggestions.json) - Royalty-free background music by mood
